title: A big payment
story: ShopBot wants to pay INR 6,000 for a party order. That's over Asha's "ask me" amount of INR 5,000, so the Guard steps up: Asha opens the link, sees the amount and shop, and approves. Then ShopBot pays. Large payments get a human look without being forbidden.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Order the party food from FreshMart for Saturday.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The party order at FreshMart comes to INR 6,000. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: This one needs your approval, Asha. I've sent it to your phone.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Asha approved. Checking the approval before I pay.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The payment is scheduled. I'll let you know once the money is taken.

what_to_notice: The Decision is step_up, not block: every Reason code is a warning sign, so the right move is to ask Asha. Here there are three: INR 6,000 is over the INR 5,000 "ask me" amount, Asha has never paid FreshMart before, and ShopBot didn't check the cart against her request. The thresholds come from the Policy pack named in the inspector, not from the code.
